title: Explicit schema-less Hostinger runtime bootstrap and recovery contract

phases.objective: Provide an explicit plan/dry-run/apply contract for GitHub or a separately configured Hostinger release hook, while preserving normal DB-backed authorization and preventing startup auto-apply.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: hostinger-runtime-bootstrap CLI or manual GitHub workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Plan mode is read-only by default; dry-run classifies target schema, ledger, postconditions, and grants; apply is limited to the canonical zero-table bundle or incident 20260815 path and requires dedicated credentials plus exact SHA/target confirmation.
steps: Validate exact Production source repository, branch, and 40-character SHA.
Validate a repository-owned target entry with database SHA-256 and target fingerprint.
Reject runtime DB credentials as bootstrap credentials and never fall back to DB_*.
Classify zero-table and nonempty databases before any baseline decision.
Allow 225 and 1048 only in dry-run/verification mode.
Allow 20260815 apply only after catalog prerequisite tables, checksum, statement count, ledger conflict checks, and declared postconditions pass.
For zero-table apply, require a same-SHA schema-only bundle manifest and runtime table-count/checksum pins; do not execute a generic migration directory.
Apply only six-table SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE grants and require same-cycle readback without GRANT OPTION or schema/global write privileges.
Expose typed bootstrap_not_configured/bootstrap_required status from startup and /deployment-info without opening a database connection.
Keep the normal GPT tool and session-context routes DB-backed and protected.
assertions: No plan/default startup/prestart/Docker start path performs database connection or mutation.
npm start, prestart, root start, and Dockerfile do not invoke the bootstrap CLI.
Missing bundle, source mismatch, table-count mismatch, or checksum mismatch blocks zero-table mutation before SQL.
A nonempty database cannot use the baseline bundle.
A schema-ready database without apply-ledger evidence remains apply-required and is never record-only reconciled.
Credential values, SQL text, and passwords are absent from bounded evidence.
The repository does not claim that Hostinger release-hook configuration exists; live operational execution remains a separate step.
